title: NativeGPU Scene v2
description: Authoritative shape of a NativeGPU scene. v1 keeps inline materials; v2 adds a named material table whose textures resolve to cooked .ngtex slices. The runtime additionally enforces unique entity UUIDs, exactly one player spawn and at least one ground; JSON Schema cannot express those cross-object invariants portably.

joints.description: XPBD joints between entities. Bodies are referenced by entity id so a joint survives the rigid world rebuild.

world.description: Reference to a cooked procedural world. The manifest and its chunks live under the project assets directory; the scene only records which manifest is current.

voronoi.description: Baked shard set (nativegpu.voronoi/1) drawn instead of box cells. Requires mode "bonded".

settings.description: runSpeed must also be greater than or equal to walkSpeed; the runtime validates that relation.
